paragraphs.text: Radomir is a Boros legionnaire and guildmage from Sunhome on the plane of Ravnica .

Radomir was assigned to watch the growing tensions in the area where Ambroz Benakov officiated, as the use of force and extortion was on the rise in the area. When Radomir witnessed the thief Tanek trip the pontiff up and steal his coin purse, Radomir pursued. Catching up with the thief after a short chase, Radomir took the gold back and demanded to know why Tanek had stolen it. When Tanek revealed it was none other than Pontiff Benakov himself who was responsible for the kidnapping and extortion that had been going on, Radomir recruited Tanek as a spy and paid him two gold from Benakov's bag for his service.
